review_candidates.description: Senior Technical Officer – WASH in Health Facilities, Maputo, Mozambique Job Code: TECH31019 Job Family: Technical Compensation Band: Band LL Reports to: Senior Technical Advisor – WASH About FHI 360: FHI 360 is a nonprofit human development organization dedicated to improving lives in lasting ways by advancing integrated, locally driven solutions. Our staff includes experts in health, education, nutrition, environment, economic development, civil society, youth, research, and technology — creating a unique mix of capabilities to address today's interrelated development challenges. We are currently seeking qualified local candidates for the position of: Senior Technical Officer – WASH in Health Facilities. The Senior Technical Officer (STO) – WASH in Health Facilities provides technical implementation support for Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) interventions in healthcare facilities and priority public health settings under the WASH and Global Health Security components of the EpiC program. The Senior Technical Officer – WASH in Health Facilities is based in Maputo. Job Summary Under the supervision of the Senior Technical Advisor- WASH, the Senior Technical Officer – WASH in Health Facilities works closely with the Ministry of Health, national public health institutions, provincial and district health authorities, healthcare facilities, laboratories, MNCH teams, implementing partners, and other stakeholders to strengthen WASH services and practices in healthcare facilities. The position supports assessment, planning, implementation, monitoring, and institutionalization of WASH interventions, with particular attention to water supply and safety, sanitation, hygiene and hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, healthcare waste management, WASH-FIT, infection prevention and control, and integration of WASH into routine health services and emergency preparedness. The position also supports integration of WASH messages and practices within MNCH services, mobile brigades, vaccination campaigns, and other priority health service delivery platforms. Accountabilities: Technical Responsibilities WASH in Health Facilities Work closely with MISAU and provincial and district health authorities to plan, implement, monitor, and institutionalize WASH priorities in healthcare facilities; Support healthcare facilities to assess and improve WASH services and practices, including water supply, water safety, sanitation, hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, healthcare waste management, and hygiene facilities; Lead and support WASH assessments using nationally approved instruments and recognized tools, including WASH FIT and other relevant WASH performance assessment tools, and translate findings into prioritized, costed, and time-bound improvement plans; Provide technical leadership and support for implementation of WASH improvement plans at national, provincial, district, and health-facility levels; Support health facilities to strengthen routine WASH systems, procedures, monitoring tools, and quality-improvement activities; Support monitoring of WASH service availability, functionality, quality, and practices and use findings to guide corrective actions and continuous improvement; Provide technical support to strengthen water safety, sanitation, hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, healthcare waste management, and hygiene practices in healthcare facilities; WASH, MNCH and Community Health Services Provide technical support to integrate WASH and hygiene practices into maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH) services and other priority health service delivery platforms; Support integration of appropriate WASH messages and practices into MNCH health facilities, mobile brigades, vaccination campaigns, and other community-based health activities; Support health workers and community health teams to promote practical WASH behaviors, including hand hygiene, safe water handling, sanitation, environmental hygiene, and infection prevention; Support development and adaptation of WASH and hygiene promotion materials for healthcare workers, community health workers, patients, caregivers, and other priority audiences; Ensure effective integration of WASH with IPC, surveillance, risk communication, community engagement, and other public health interventions; Support WASH preparedness and response measures in healthcare facilities and communities during outbreaks and other public health emergencies, including cholera, other waterborne diseases, and epidemic-prone diseases; Global Health Security and Outbreak Preparedness Participate in WASH readiness assessments, rapid response activities, outbreak investigations, and implementation of corrective and preventive measures; Support coordinated outbreak-response approaches linking WASH, IPC, surveillance, laboratories, case management, risk communication, community engagement, and emergency preparedness; Contribute to development and implementation of WASH preparedness plans, SOPs, technical guidance, and response tools; Provide on-site or remote WASH technical support during public health emergencies, including rapid WASH risk assessments, water safety, sanitation, hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, healthcare waste management, and continuity of essential WASH services; Capacity Strengthening and Supportive Supervision Develop and deliver training, mentorship, Training-of-Trainers, and supportive supervision for healthcare workers and relevant technical staff on WASH in healthcare facilities; Support development and adaptation of SOPs, job aids, training materials, assessment tools, and technical guidance related to WASH and hygiene; Conduct field visits to monitor implementation and support continuous improvement of WASH services and practices; Provide coaching and mentoring to health facility teams on WASH-FIT, WASH improvement plans, monitoring, and routine quality improvement; Assess training effectiveness and support trained national and provincial facilitators to cascade standardized content, mentor frontline teams, and maintain training quality; Program Implementation, Coordination and Monitoring 5. Ability to develop technical guidance, SOPs, monitoring tools, and high-quality program documentation; Strong analytical, coordination, communication, and stakeholder-engagement skills; Ability to work effectively with government institutions and multidisciplinary teams; Fluency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English; Competencies: Project Management (Planning and Time Management) - Accurately scopes out length and difficulty of tasks (sets objectives/goals/measures). Arranges information in a useful manner and orchestrates multiple activities at once. Anticipates the effects of process change on people while optimizing task efficiency and simplicity. Exercises good judgment with selecting methods and techniques to determine appropriate action. Decisions may cause delays and affect a work unit or area within a department. Identifies and raises issues to senior technical staff. Networks with key internal and external personnel. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Environmental Health, WASH, Health Systems, Global Health, or a related field. A Master's degree in Public Health, Environmental Health, WASH, Health Systems, Global Health, or a related field, is strongly preferred. Experience Required: Minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in WASH, public health, environmental health, health systems strengthening, or related areas – with a Master’s Degree. Minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in WASH, public health, environmental health, health systems strengthening, or related areas - with a Bachelor’s Degree. Experience using WASH performance assessment tools, including WASH-FIT, and supporting training and supportive supervision. Experience working with government health institutions at national and/or sub-national level. Preferred/Desirable: Experience designing and facilitating Training of Trainers (ToT), evaluating learning, and supporting training cascades. Come, and be where it begins. Your role will include all Test activities related to developing cloud native products that are scalable, maintainable handling large data ingestion, data pipelines and visualizing to the end user, collaborating with backend, frontend, and domain experts. Our focus is ensuring the quality of simple, optimal, scalable software architecture using microservices on lean and agile ways of working. We are organized in cross-functional multi-domain development teams in which we foster continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing. What you will do: Create and execute test strategies for each code change starting from integration and system tests, through Regression testing, Performance testing, Data quality testing, Security testing all the way up to UAT, exploratory tests and non - functional tests, the goal is to automate as much of the testing effort as possible with a minimum set of code, execution time, and Cost. Integrate testing scripts within CI/CD pipelines following CI/CD strategies. Work as part of Agile teams to design and develop test plans, test cases, edge cases, test scripts and tools for quality assurance of our products and ensure code quality, fast feedback, and adherence to software testing best practices. Collaborate with Agile Teams, the Product Owner, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, refine user stories, define, and prioritize quality goals and test requirements, track and resolve defects, and other work the team needs to accomplish during and before the Sprint. Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, tools, test suites, documentation, and test artifacts for cloud-based applications and infrastructure. Utilize both manual and automated testing tools and techniques to ensure thorough coverage and maintain the quality of software releases. Identify, document, and track defects, issues, and enhancements in a centralized Collaboration and Tracking system. Analyze test results, identify trends, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Review and provide feedback on the product architecture and design to ensure that it's conducive to test automation, robustness, and scalability. Participate in agile development processes and ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint retrospectives. Understand and represent both the business and technology. Stay current with industry trends, tools, and technologies in software testing and cloud computing. Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, security, and data protection standards. Provide mentoring and guidance to team members in QA best practices and cloud technologies. Work with the team to address project scope, quality, cost, and Time related issues The skills you bring: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum 3+ years of experience overall in Software Quality Assurance Roles. Minimum 2+ years of experience in software testing automation. Strong Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MongoDB. Proficiency in using any of test automation tools and frameworks, such as Robot Framework, Cucumber, Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Pytest, TestNG, JMeter or similar tools. Proven experience with scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Bash). Proven experience with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C#) for developing test automation tools and suites. Certifications in software testing (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) or test automation tools is highly desirable. Proficiency in API testing tools that require strong coding skills to create tests: Postman and REST Assured. Experience in code coverage and static analysis tools, such as SonarQube, Coveralls, or similar tools. Experience in Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools, such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Travis CI. Experience in Cloud Native applications, Microservices, Micro-frontend, and Data workflows. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes is highly desirable and considered a significant asset. Experience in Cloud Platforms such as AWS/GCP/Azure, etc. is highly desirable and considered a significant asset. Experience in MLOps is a plus. Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and working in multidisciplinary teams. Strong analytical skills and ability to identify, troubleshoot, and document software issues. Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on driving results. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work autonomously as well as collaboratively within a team. Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You will build and scale high-throughput, event-driven microservices that seamlessly synchronize product taxonomy, merchandising attributes, digital assets, and item lifecycles between Akeneo PIM, upstream ERP/Digital Content systems, and downstream real-time consumers/E-commerce engines. Engineer Complex Data Models: Implement scalable product hierarchy models, variant structures (CSC/SKU levels), reference entities, category mappings, and delta-calculation engines for real-time and batch synchronization. Orchestrate Cross-System Connections: Build high-reliability connectors and APIs integrating PIM with upstream systems (Intellimas, Creative Force / DAM, ItemDB) and downstream consumers (Product Fulcrum, Constructor/Bloomreach Search, E-commerce storefronts). Optimize Production Stability: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain the live Akeneo PIM platform to ensure 24/7 availability and minimal downtime across global retail brands. Perform Fine-Tuning & Performance Optimization: Continuously optimize API response times, database query performance, and payload processing within Akeneo to handle rapidly growing catalog data. Drive Continuous Feature Enhancements: Collaborate with business stakeholders to design and deploy incremental features, custom attributes, and localized catalog workflows in the live system. Govern Data Integrity & Upgrades: Partner with the Akeneo SaaS/Enterprise support teams to plan, test, and execute seamless platform upgrades and patches while maintaining data accuracy. QUALIFICATIONS: Strong proficiency in building robust, secure microservices and API architectures (RESTful, SOAP) using Java, Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), Node.js / TypeScript, Go, or Python. Deep hands-on experience with distributed streaming platforms and message-oriented middleware. Expert knowledge of the publisher/subscriber model, including Apache Kafka (topic architecture, consumer groups, partition strategies, schema registry, event headers), RabbitMQ, and IBM MQ. Solid experience designing and optimizing relational, NoSQL, and memory-cached databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, CloudSQL, MongoDB, Redis). Expert in query optimization tailored for high-volume catalog, SKU, and enterprise datasets. Practical experience deploying, managing, and orchestrating workloads in agile, cloud-native environments across GCP, AWS, or Azure. Proficient with Kubernetes (GKE), Docker, and enterprise CI/CD automation tools (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Bamboo). Strong foundational understanding of modern security concepts, including authentication protocols, Single Sign-On (SSO), and secure data transmission. Nice to have: Experience working with enterprise Product Information Management (PIM) and catalog management solutions such as Akeneo. Background in data migration strategies (delta loads, reconciliation scripts, and dual-entry cutover planning) Knowledge in API security Gateway Frameworks/ concepts Experience in application serves such as weblogic, tomcat etc Working knowledge of Gradle Working knowledge of, Grafana / Splunk
